questions.stem: What is a digital ring block indicated for?
questions.answer: Finger and toe surgery, e.g. nail bed repair

questions.stem: Which nerves supply the palmar digital nerves of a finger?
Which nerves supply the dorsal digital nerves of a finger?
Around each finger phalanx, at what clock positions do the digital nerves lie?
In a digital ring block, where is the needle first inserted?
In a digital ring block, what is the endpoint for advancing the needle along the phalanx?
In a digital ring block, how is the LA injected once the needle is placed?
In a digital ring block, where is the needle reinserted for the second side?
questions.answer: Medial to the extensor tendon, then repeat

questions.stem: What is the levobupivacaine dose for a digital ring block?
When is a metacarpal or metatarsal block used?
questions.answer: When surgery is at the base of the finger

questions.stem: At what angle to the skin is the needle placed for a metacarpal block?
Where is the needle placed for a metacarpal block?
questions.answer: Between the metacarpals, about midway along the bone

questions.stem: In a metacarpal block, when should needle advancement stop?
After one side of a metacarpal block is injected, what is the next step?
questions.answer: Repeat on the other side of the finger

questions.stem: How is digital ischaemia prevented after a digital ring block?
options: Avoid adrenaline and limit the injected volume
